groups.reason: Written under the old family rule, which excluded the ideology's own self-definitions (organisations and thinkers saying what it is) as if they were member movements' platforms. Only platforms are coatracks; self-definitions are defining sources (AUDIT_RULES.md section 3).

Applied the old family approach without the flag (answered only from what branches share, or from the label alone, excluding the ideology's own self-definitions). Answer from the defining sources: self-definitions count, platforms are coatracks (AUDIT_RULES.md section 3).

intersecting-oppressions was reworded (2026-11-10) to "Overlapping forms of oppression must be addressed together.": it asks whether linked oppressions are addressed together, not whether they have equal priority (priority is material-over-identity and racial-oppression-before-sexism). Recheck this answer against your sources: putting one oppression first (e.g. class) is not by itself a reason to disagree; rejecting the framework, or treating each oppression as separable, is.
